reference_method.note: The recent rolling 24-hour mean is ranked against approved HYDAT daily means on the same calendar date in each prior year.

method.percentile: mid-rank empirical percentile of the 24-hour mean; minimum and maximum have no percentile

history_notes.level_and_flow: usable_years counts prior years with an approved HYDAT daily mean on the comparison date (same date) or on at least 8 of the 15 window days (seasonal window); water level counts only years on the same datum as today's reading. history_notes.temperature: No historical comparison for water or air temperature: HYDAT holds no temperature for these stations and ECCC's real-time service keeps only 18 months. Recent values are shown without a percentile.
